title: OUTREACH EVENT ANNOUNCEMENT: ARCHITECT AND ENGINEERING (A-E) SERVICES FOR SURVEYING AND MAPPING TO SUPPORT THE CARIBBEAN DISTRICT AND USACE
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION SOUTH ATLANTIC.ENDIST CARIBBEAN.W2SR ENDIST CARIBBEAN(PROVIS)
detail_text: OUTREACH EVENT - The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Caribbean District is planning to procure services for surveying and mapping to support various civil works projects. These projects may include, but are not limited to, topographic surveys, property/boundary surveys, geodetic control surveys, construction surveys, and inland hydrographic surveys. The scope of work will cover projects within the geographic boundaries of the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico and the United States Virgin Islands.
